threads.body: Together 3 includes `/v1` in its resource paths, but `conformance.yaml:14` still sets `TOGETHER_BASE_URL` to `${MOCK_SERVER_URL}/v1`. This produces `/v1/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/v1/embeddings`, which the mock does not serve, so the scenarios fail with 404s instead of collecting results. Change that environment variable to `${MOCK_SERVER_URL}` alongside this upgrade, then rerun the scenarios and commit any regenerated results.
